title: eval-harness: integrate CI metrics exporter and prompt-set regression gating
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds CI exporter that uploads eval metrics and enforces prompt-set regression thresholds; no user-facing API changes.
description: Context: The eval harness needs tighter CI-level quality gating for prompt-set regressions and better visibility of evaluation metrics in PRs. This change integrates a lightweight CI metrics exporter and a gating hook that fails PRs when configured prompt-set thresholds regress beyond allowed tolerance. Motivation: We had multiple incidents where prompt improvements in upstream code unintentionally regressed production prompts (see ENG-2345). Automated gating reduces manual intervention and shortens the feedback loop. What this PR does: - Adds a CI metrics exporter that runs eval-harness suites in headless mode and uploads a compact metrics payload (JSONL) to the CI artifacts bucket. - Implements a new GitHub Actions job (eval-metrics-check) which compares current run metrics against baseline metrics stored in the repo (eval_baselines/*.json) and applies configured thresholds per prompt-set. - Adds configuration for per-prompt-set tolerances (eval-config/prompt_gates.yaml) and a fast-fail path for regressions exceeding thresholds. - Adds unit + integration tests for the exporter, comparator, and gating logic. - Adds docs for maintainers (docs/ci-metrics.md) and a troubleshooting checklist. Checklist: - [x] Metrics exporter implementation (python) - [x] GitHub Actions job and workflow - [x] Comparator and gating logic - [x] Baseline metrics plumbing and example baselines - [x] Tests and CI passes - [x] Docs and maintainers guide Notes on thresholds: Default gating is conservative (0.5% absolute drop allowed for primary metric; configurable per-prompt). Owners can opt-out by adding a [skip-eval-gate] tag to PR title for emergency patches. Rollout plan: staged rollout — enabled for eval-harness repo first, then for redwood and example repos after 2 weeks of observation. Related: ENG-2345, ENG-2401, SUP-1023. Design considerations: keep exporter runtime < 6m on CI by running sampled prompt-sets and caching model artifacts; ensure artifact payloads are compact; comparator avoids flakiness by smoothing over 3-run median when available.
commits: 1) feat: add ci metrics exporter and comparator; 2) ci: new GitHub Actions eval-metrics-check workflow; 3) feat: prompt_gates.yaml baseline and example baselines; 4) test: add unit/integration tests and fixture baselines; 5) docs: add ci-metrics.md and troubleshooting notes

notes: This PR intentionally keeps gating conservative. Teams that own prompt-sets should review eval_baselines and set prompt_gates.yaml thresholds before broad rollout. If a flakey PR is blocked, maintainers can trigger the 're-run with baseline' workflow or append [skip-eval-gate] to bypass temporarily. Monitoring: dashboards added to Console onboarding (alert: EvalGateFailureRate > 0.5% over 1h).
